notes.title: Scramble: Battle of Britain – Pilots & Squadron Update
notes.content: [p]Back in December last year, we launched our Squadron Leader Game Mode, which lets players step into the shoes of a WWII leader and manage a squadron through a 30-day single-player campaign, learning how to combine different pilot traits, when to send people on leave, and how to rebuild a balanced crew after casualties.[/p][p]Squadron Leader quickly became one of the most played and appreciated parts of our Early Access journey, and ever since, we’ve been thinking about how to take it to the next level.[/p][p]Today, with the [b]Pilots & Squadron Update[/b], we’re expanding on that foundation, adding deeper improvements to both the squadron and pilot layers.[/p][h2]What’s New in the Pilots & Squadron Update?[/h2][p]We’ve introduced a number of systems and mechanics that shape how pilots behave, grow, and impact your squadron:[/p][list][*][p]Newly created squadrons will be populated with pilots of varying experience levels and sortie counts.[/p][/*][*][p]Pilot traits improve and worsen according to each pilot’s experience, readiness, and morale. [/p][/*][*][p]Every pilot now has experience, readiness, and morale states that adjust according to individual and squadron performance.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Veteran pilots will see improved leadership abilities, while inexperienced pilots will struggle in leadership roles.[/p][/*][*][p]Pilots will become rusty without regular combat sorties.[/p][/*][*][p]Pilot and squadron morale will fluctuate in coordination with success and failure.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Pilot wellness states (like Rusty or Veteran) generate positive or negative modifier traits.[/p][/*][*][p]Traits influence base performance and can be improved or worsened over time.[/p][/*][*][p]A “Sortie History” interactive calendar tracks the results of every mission flown with detailed statistics and match replay files.[/p][/*][/list][p]The Pilots & Squadron update deepens strategic decisionmaking in the Squadron Leader game mode, and the new mechanics will help players tell a more rich and emotional story of each squadron. Pilot Trait modifications are another important building block for our in-development Channel Defense Campaign. We will continue adding new pilot traits and trait modifications in each update on our road to leaving Early Access.In addition to Squadron Leader mechanics, this update is packed with improvements to Scramble VFX and bug fixes. As usual, you can find the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1530450/discussions/0/601900367173707469/"]full changelog history here[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Download Scramble: Battle of Britain Now[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1530450/Scramble_Battle_of_Britain/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

A “Sortie History” interactive calendar tracks the results of every mission flown with detailed statistics and match replay files.

notes.title: New Bombers, New Battles: The Do17 Lands in Scramble
notes.content:
A major update has just landed in Scramble: Battle of Britain, and with it comes a new challenge for RAF pilots: the [b]Dornier 17[/b], one of the Luftwaffe’s most iconic twin-engine bombers, is now available as an AI-controlled enemy in the core game!

With the arrival of the Do 17, we’re introducing a brand-new layer of tactical complexity to bomber engagements. Players will encounter this new threat in [b]fresh missions featuring enhanced mechanics and an improved UI[/b] that will help to track, intercept, and break up the [b]new enemy formations[/b].

We have reinforced every aspect of bomber intercept missions in Scramble. Pilots may now find [b]bombers escorted by enemy fighters[/b] who join the dogfight on a turn delay. Bombers AI will employ evasive maneuvers, and a depleted bomber formation may decide to turn and retreat rather than continue to their objective. 

Scramble [b]bombers are now modeled with animated bomb bay doors and slings[/b]. Damaged bombers will jettison their payloads before turning for home, and aircraft with multiple stations will bail all their live crew when fatally damaged. 

[b]Watch the Do17 in action: [/b]
[previewyoutube=ZXxEUqY29pY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Meet the Dornier 17 and New Enemy Formations[/h3]
Nicknamed “The Flying Pencil” for its sleek, narrow design, the Dornier 17 was a fast, agile, low-level bomber that caught many RAF airfields off guard in the early stages of the war.
Its maneuverability at low altitudes, combined with multiple defensive gun positions, makes it a serious threat in the sky. A well-coordinated Do 17 formation can saturate the air with suppressive fire, forcing RAF pilots to rely on teamwork, timing, and precision. But don’t stick around too long: enemy fighters will be on your tail, diving in to provide top cover for the bombers.

[h3]A Lens On: Battle of Britain - EP.3 | [i]Icons of the Sky: the Planes of the Battle[/i][/h3]
If you want to dive deeper into other legendary aircraft of the Battle of Britain, we have just released Episode 3 of our editorial video series, A Lens On: Battle of Britain

[b]Watch Episode 3 now:[/b]
[previewyoutube=AJXRPHBqFlI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Join the Pilot Community and Share Your Feedback[/h3]
This is a big step in the [b]Early Access journey of Scramble: Battle of Britain[/b], and we want your input! Join the community on [url=https://discord.gg/2hPRMJ6bhU]Discord [/url]to discuss tactics, share replays, and stay up to date on future content drops
Keep your sights on the skies, more is coming soon.

[b]Buy Scramble: Battle of Britain[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1530450/Scramble_Battle_of_Britain/

notes.title: Scramble: Battle of Britain – The Hawker Hurricane Joins the Fight!
notes.content:
After debuting as a preview in the open beta, the legendary [b]Hawker Hurricane[/b], a pivotal force in the Battle of Britain, has officially landed in the main game as a [b]new playable RAF fighter[/b]! 

For those who missed our latest update: we introduced a beta branch, accessible to all Early Access players, where we [b]test work-in-progress content before it reaches the core game[/b]. The Hurricane was the first feature added there, but the beta will remain open throughout the Early Access journey of the game, with frequent content updates.

[b]Pilots, this is your call to action![/b] Help shape the future of Scramble by sharing your feedback and battle replays. Join our community on Discord to share your experiences with other players and stay informed about upcoming content: https://discord.gg/2hPRMJ6bhU


Before you take off, [b]check out our latest video[/b] showcasing the Hurricane’s main features and read a few curiosities about the workhorse of the Battle of Britain:

[previewyoutube=V6peBRlrs94;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]The Hawker Hurricane’s impact on aviation history[/h3]

The Hawker Hurricane played a critical role in the Battle of Britain, accounting for an impressive 60% of the RAF’s air victories during the conflict. Though the Supermarine Spitfire often steals the spotlight, the Hurricane was the backbone of the Royal Air Force, known for its reliability and combat effectiveness against enemy formations in nearly every major theatre in the Second World War.

Built with a steel-tube fuselage covered in fabric, the Hurricane was able to endure significant damage while remaining operational. Its thick wings allowed for remarkable maneuverability, making it ideal for tight dogfights. This robust construction also made it easier for ground crews to repair, keeping it battle-ready for longer.

Beyond the battlefield, the Hurricane remains a cultural icon, frequently celebrated in historical documentaries and airshows. Its contributions to the RAF's success have secured its place in aviation history, inspiring generations of war historians and flight enthusiasts.

[h3]Tactical Tips for using the Hurricane in Scramble: Battle of Britain[/h3]

In Scramble: Battle of Britain, the Hurricane is faithfully recreated to reflect its wartime strengths. Its durability and steady gun platform make it perfect for delivering precise strikes against enemy bombers and fighters alike. The aircraft’s exceptional maneuverability gives players the edge in close-quarters combat, holding aim steady in the heat of battle.

While the Spitfire remains famed for its speed and sleek design, the Hurricane excels in resilience and firepower. Its reliability makes it particularly effective against bombers, while the Spitfire’s speed often makes it better suited for interception roles. Your choice of aircraft depends on whether you value durability and sustained firepower or speed and interception tactics.

The addition of the Hawker Hurricane lets you experience first-hand the power and resilience of this legendary aircraft. Take to the skies and see if you can turn the tide of battle, just like the heroes of 1940.

notes.title: Squadron Leader Update - v.010.004
notes.content:
Tally ho, pilots!

Exciting news is on the horizon! We're gearing up to open a [b]new beta branch[/b] exclusively for Early Access users, giving you the opportunity to playtest upcoming content in development—stay tuned!

In the meantime, we've just released a [b]major update[/b] packed with enhancements to the [b]Squadron Leader experience[/b], including improved balance, new Leadership Traits, and detailed progress reports.
This update also features a host of bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements.

Read more details in the full changelog below:

[h2]Squadron Leader Update 1
v.010.004 - Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Enhancements[/h3]

[b]Squadron Leader[/b]

[list]
[*] Every pilot is generated with one Leadership trait (upon Start New Squadron)
[*] Leadership traits impact a leader's whole section on a per-mission basis
[*] New After Action Report is presented to the player after every mission
[*] New Squadron Summary Report is available to the player to track the progress of their SQL squadron
[*] Gamepad support added to all SQL menus
[*] Pilot traits color in Section Assignment to help discern between pilots
[*] Confirmation prompt added to "Start New Squadron" method
[*] SQL long-form game balanced to be less punishing
[*] SQL scenario generation is more intentional, and informed by leadership traits
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous[/b]

[list]
[*] Button/Input glyphs updated and customized for popular gamepads
[*] VFX visual enhancements
[*] How to Play section renders currently assigned input glyphs
[*] Option added to constrain mouse pointer to game window
[*] Increased pool of Luftwaffe pilot names
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Dogfight[/b]

[list]
[*] Aircraft physics fixed for planes flying straight & level (notable for Stukas and fighters in Level Flight mode)
[*] Pilots and cockpit art of dead/escaped aircraft should no longer hang in sky
[*] Aircraft Health/Status panel fixes for some aircraft
[*] Damage & Debris art fixes for all aircraft
[*] Pilot Actions semi-circle menu no longer locks open
[*] Stukas now fly in a single formation
[*] Match score bug fixes
[/list]
[b]Squadron Leader[/b]

[list]
[*] Section animation at Scramble fixed
[*] Pilot duplication fixed
[*] SQL save data integrity improved
[/list]
[b]Miscellaneous[/b]

[list]
[*] Typos fixed in pilot traits
[*] “Controls Not Modified" no longer appears in match opening screen
[*] Improved support for wide monitor resolutions
[*] VSync fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Scramble: Battle of Britain - Play the demo
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that the major update to the Scramble demo is out now!
We can't wait to hear your feedback. Enjoy the new update.
Here’s a list of the new features included in this version:

[b]Aircraft[/b]
[list]
[*] Player can now fly the Me 109
[*] Me 110 now appears as enemy aircraft
[/list]
[b]Missions[/b]
[list]
[*] New pack of missions to showcase 109 and 110. 110 also crops up in some existing missions!
[/list]
[b]Gameplay options[/b]
[list]
[*] Metric measurements now supported
[*] Option to reset controls to zero at the start of each turn
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] New-look menus with improved controller and keyboard functionality
[*] Menu flow and UX unified and improved
[/list]
[b]In-game[/b]
[list]
[*] Game can now be played with a mouse (this is very WIP and not refined!)
[*] Player is now warned about dangerous loss of speed and potential stalling
[*] Player can click on plane icons at top of screen to select individual aircraft
[*] Score screen improved to give better breakdown
[*] New pilot portraits added
[*] Luftwaffe pilots now have portraits
[*] Level flight autopilot option to reduce busy work for players
[/list]
[b]Match replay[/b]
[list]
[*] Improvements to Replay system include unbroken playback option 
[*] Review phase UI and tools improved (e.g., player can now view entire match to date after any turn)
[/list]
Too many bugfixes, balancing tweaks and performance improvements to mention!
